versions.changelog:
Initial release of the new-user-product-audit skill.

- Enables agents to perform hands-on new user audits of ZenStory AI Web products from a real user perspective.
- Guides through full onboarding, first project creation, and major usage scenarios, explicitly recording pain points, bugs, and user motivation.
- Separates “facts” (objective product behavior) from “opinions” (user/agent perception) to prioritize actionable improvements.
- Provides step-by-step methods, reporting requirements, security boundaries, and checklists for authentic user journey documentation.
- Delivers a Chinese evidence-based diagnostic report designed for product teams to directly prioritize issues.
